sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt:
USE OF PROCEEDS Unless otherwise specified in a prospectus supplement, Mexico will use the net proceeds from
the sale of securities for the general purposes of the Mexican Government, including the refinancing, repurchase or retirement of its domestic and external indebtedness, as well as delivering a portion of such proceeds to Mexico’s state-owned
companies ( Petróleos Mexicanos (PEMEX) and the Comisión Federal de Electricidad ) as the Mexican Government considers appropriate as authorized under Article 2 of the Federal Revenue Law for 2026 (or the corresponding subsequent year), including in the form capital contributions by the Mexican
